title: A gate whose question says rule is classed agents-rule only when it is about a rule-guarding file
goal: Retrospective of SP-wgx4pq4r: bl_authority's agents-rule pattern matches the bare word rule, so BG-47kw57ed's worker saw a design question about which distill rows count turn into a blocking operator gate, and reworded the question to get past it. A gate on an item whose touches name no rule-guarding path is not classed agents-rule for the word rule alone, a gate the pattern does class names the matched words, kb/_self/backlog.md says so, and the authority tests pass.
notes: Merged from ST-mzajj2el “bl_authority classes a gate push by what it decides, not by the word 'release' in its quoted subject” at the 2026-10-10 backlog triage: Same defect as ST-yn3fa5ts (bl_authority QUESTION_WORDS matches a bare word): premise reproduces, a question with 'release' derives class push. Fold into the one story that fixes word-sense classing. Its goal: S3 gap found in SP-vayhvwfy: ST-hcc7a3fd's worker recorded a provisional gate about the 'Sonnet 5.5 model release' question; the word 'release' classed it push (an OPERATOR_CLASSES class), so answer --provisional was refused and the item waited on the operator for a content triage choice. The push class is given by what the gate decides (a push, a branch, a tag, a release of the kb), not by the word appearing in quoted subject matter, as BG-qe46klco narrowed STRAY_KEY. Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;q='How is the Sonnet 5.5 release question dispositioned?';hit=bool(a.QUESTION_WORDS['push'].search(q));print('push classes a quoted release subject:',hit);sys.exit(1 if hit else 0)"]} Its touches: _tools/bl_authority.py, kb/_self/backlog.md Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 8 of 13, "Gates: commands, classing and host checks"); the triage reviewer found it serves the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test F2: a content sprint from the research queue lands on headless Sonnet workers.
